# SolarElectric

> Solar PV installation company based in Noordhoek, Cape Town, South Africa. Installing residential, commercial and off-grid solar systems since 2015.

SolarElectric is a licensed, registered EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) company with over 40 years of combined electrical experience, 10 years in energy management, and 10 years in solar PV solutions. Our electricians and installers are registered with the Department of Labour (DoL). We design and install systems using Tier 1 solar panels (Aiko, Canadian, JA Solar), inverter brands (Sunsynk, Deye, Sigenergy, Sungrow, Solis) and lithium battery systems (Sungrow, SigenStor, Eenovance), and provide SSEG-compliant installations with COC and PR Electrical Engineer sign-off. We serve Noordhoek, Fish Hoek, Constantia, Cape Town and the greater Western Cape.

Contact: +27 83 571 9191 / +27 83 454 3577, info@solarelectricwise.co.za, 1 Heldray Rd, Noordhoek, 7979, South Africa. Hours: Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00.
